posts.title: 2025 Year in Review
posts.description: Year 2025 saw me transition into a full time Aerospace Engineering faculty role at Cal Poly, SLO. See the article to learn more about my future activities.

posts.title: 2024 SCTC and IEPC Debrief
posts.description: I spent the last two weeks of June 2024 in southern France attending two back-to-back technical conferences: SCTC and IEPC. This post is a brief debrief and a summary of the presented research.

posts.title: Development of a Solid Fuel Adamantane Ion Thruster
posts.description: This post summarizes current work by the USC undergraduate student club ASPEN to develop a solid fuel plasma thruster operating on Adamantane.
